statement: PLATFORM Merchant profile maintenance and operating markets must remain distinct from legal registration identity and lifecycle transitions.
scope: profile-update authorization, concurrency, idempotency, and audit
platform Merchant list and detail interaction
given: an MCH-001 Merchant in ACTIVE or DISABLED state
append-only V34, V35 and V36 migrations and a protected system Role
when: a protected PLATFORM operator edits a Merchant profile
a PLATFORM operator views or filters the Merchant list
an existing V33 Merchant has no proven operating market
then: MCH-002 keeps registrationCountry as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 legal-registration fact and never presents it as a market.
marketCodes is a multiple ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 operating-market set whose current values are BRA and PHL; legacy rows may return empty while updates require at least one value.
Only merchant:update held by the same protected PLATFORM system Role with recent step-up authorizes PUT /api/platform/merchants/{merchantId}/profile.

The exact update fields are expectedVersion, Idempotency-Key semantics, legalName, displayName, merchantTypeCode, legalPersonName, authenticationType, remarks and marketCodes; no Tenant or registration selector is accepted.

Only ACTIVE and DISABLED may update; a no-op is rejected, status and statusReasonCode remain unchanged and rowVersion increments exactly once; historical status reason remains null when exact evidence is absent and is never inferred.
UPDATE_PROFILE and server-derived PLATFORM_PROFILE_UPDATED bind permanent idempotency and audit in the same transaction.
The list uses a Switch only for ACTIVE and DISABLED, a Tag otherwise, Detail and Edit actions, allowClear selects, and no routine detail disable, enable or terminate action.

Merchant Type, Legal Person Name and Authentication Type are retained while business email is excluded; those classifications never create Tenant, AgentRelation, MerchantMarket or authorization scope, and append-only V35 extends the already executed V34 without rewriting it.

The command schema 1 compatibility path is replay-only: a complete V34 profile body may return an authorized existing deduplication result, while a miss, a partial V35 shape or any attempted legacy new write fails closed.

Before V34, exact V33 duplicate Merchant audit versions fail closed before status-reason backfill; append-only V36 enforces one merchant_audit_event per Merchant version, and ambiguous V34/V35 history requires a separately approved forward repair.
Merchant Type values are DIRECT, INDIRECT, COMMISSION, SALES and PLATFORM; Authentication Type values are ENTERPRISE, NON_PROFIT_ORGANIZATIONS, CLIQUE, INDIVIDUAL and INDIVIDUAL_HOUSEHOLD.
counterexamples: registrationCountry is renamed to market or stores BRA and PHL.
V34 guesses an operating market for a V33 Merchant.
a MERCHANT actor or ordinary PLATFORM Role edits the profile.
a pending, rejected or terminated Merchant is edited through the PLATFORM profile command.
a profile update changes status or commits without idempotency and audit.
the detail drawer exposes disable, enable or terminate as routine actions.
a profile classification is treated as a Tenant, AgentRelation, MerchantMarket or authorization selector.
